annotation.authors_or_issuer: Group of Governmental Experts on Emerging Technologies in the Area of Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems, CCW
key_provisions_or_claims: IHL continues to apply fully to development and use of LAWS
LAWS must not be used if incapable of complying with IHL
Control over such systems is needed to uphold distinction, proportionality and precautions
States should limit target types, duration, geographic scope and scale, and train operators
Legal weapons reviews required for new weapons; voluntary best-practice exchange encouraged
annotation.summary_en: Report of the 2023 CCW Group of Governmental Experts on lethal autonomous weapons systems. It records participation and proceedings and adopts consensus conclusions: IHL fully applies, LAWS incapable of IHL compliance must not be used, human control is needed, and States should limit targets, scope and duration and train operators. It recommends future-work modalities.
